label: Sling button
desc: A button you pull back like a slingshot and release: it stretches, springs back and flings a spark the other way; click, Enter and Space fire a short sling.
use: Playful primary actions such as send, boost or launch (inline-flex; the button needs about 60px of free space around it for the pull).

label: Slosh gauge
desc: A tank gauge (vertical slider) whose liquid sloshes when the level changes; drag it, use the arrow keys or drive it from props.
use: Fill levels, quotas, battery or volume controls (inline-block; set height in px).

label: Spring check
desc: A native checkbox whose box squashes, springs the tick in with an overshoot and sends out a ring; supports an indeterminate dash.
use: Preferences, task lists and consent forms (works inside a form, controlled or uncontrolled).

label: Status mark
desc: A compact status indicator that redraws per state (idle, loading, success, warning, error) and announces changes through a live region.
use: Next to a save, upload or sync action to show its outcome (inline-flex).

label: Swipe row
desc: A list row that slides left to reveal action buttons, a long swipe commits the last action; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Delete and tabbable buttons give keyboard equivalents.
use: Inbox, task and notification lists (block-level; stack several in a list).

label: Swipe toast
desc: A toast notification you flick away sideways; Escape, arrow keys and a close button dismiss it, and it auto-dismisses with a timer that pauses on hover and focus.
use: Save confirmations and errors (render it in a fixed corner container; role=alert for errors).

label: Thought line
desc: A text field with a living underline that ripples while you type, settles flat when you pause and fills as the character budget is used.
use: Titles, quick notes and prompts with a character limit (block-level, fills its parent up to 340px).

label: Voice pill
desc: A pill toggle for voice input: the mic swells into a live level meter with a running timer, and start and stop are announced.
use: Dictation or voice-note buttons in composers and search bars (pass level for a real input meter).

label: Wake slider
desc: A slide-to-confirm control where the moon rises into a sun; drag to the end or use the keyboard (arrows, End or Enter, Home or Escape).
use: Confirm-by-gesture actions such as unlock, resume session or turn on (block-level, up to 320px wide).

label: Warm tooltip
desc: A tooltip that waits a beat on first hover but opens instantly when moving along a row of controls; opens on focus, closes with Escape and is hoverable.
use: Icon-only buttons and toolbars (wrap one focusable element; leave room above it).
